title: A constant factor pulls out of the integral
statement: For a constant c, a function F, endpoints a <= b, and uniform-continuity witnesses for F and c*F on [a,b]: integral (fun t => c * F t) a b hab ucF is Equiv to c * integral F a b hab uF.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.integral_scale : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : CReal) -> CReal)) -> ((x2 : CReal) -> ((x3 : CReal) -> ((x4 : CReal.le x2 x3) -> ((x5 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn x1 x2 x3) -> ((x6 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn (fun (x6 : CReal) => CReal.mul x0 (x1 x6)) x2 x3) -> CReal.Equiv (CReal.integral (fun (x7 : CReal) => CReal.mul x0 (x1 x7)) x2 x3 x4 x6) (CReal.mul x0 (CReal.integral x1 x2 x3 x4 x5)))))))))
